application_guidance.input_pattern: An adaptive deterministic algorithm with feasible exact-jet access and a fixed query cap.
read_original_when: Extending to randomized algorithms, outside-ball queries, noisy jets or fixed low dimension
sensitive_conditions: Final direction must be orthogonal also to the arbitrary output
Full tensor equality must be preserved
Threshold must strictly exceed epsilon for failure

complexity_scope.guarantee: Existence of one fixed admissible instance with the explicit finite-N residual obstruction.
complexity_scope.hidden_constants: Only fixed p and fixed gate via Bp; no dimension factor. Let Q=LpD^p/epsilon, alpha=2/(3p-1), c_res=1/[2^p8Bp16^(p-1)]. Section11.3 gives T>=max{1,(c_res Q)^alpha-1}>=(c_res)^alpha Q^alpha/2.
complexity_scope.oracle: One feasible exact order-p call returns all tensors through derivative order p-1.
complexity_scope.output_and_metric: Feasible xhat; tangent residual dist(0,F_V(xhat)+N_X(xhat)); no additional certificate requirement.
complexity_scope.regime: d>=2N+2, N>=1, p>=2, Lp,R>0. High-dimensional worst case; R=D/2 for complexity.
complexity_scope.resource: Worst-case cap N original-F calls; internal measurable operations unrestricted; early stopping padded with ignored queries.
complexity_scope.upper_witness_or_lower_coverage: All adaptive deterministic feasible-query algorithms, arbitrary feasible output including unqueried output.

evidence.statement_check: Theorem11.1, equation11.1 and full returned-tensor consistency argument checked; calibration checked against pp30–31.

content.intended_use: Provide the deterministic hardness interface for the shared analytic family.

dependencies: Source Section11.3 pp30–31 normalization and Lemma11.5
map: Pad an early-stopped algorithm to N ignored feasible queries, preserving saved output.
At query t choose unit vt orthogonal to span{v1,...,v_{t-1},x1,...,xt}; dimension is at most 2t-1<d.
Return the full jet at xt of F_t(x)=lambda[x-cv1-q sum_{i=1}^{t-1}h_tau(<vi,x>)v_{i+1}], with empty sum for t=1. All directions used in this formula are then defined.
After the last answer, choose vm=v_{N+1} orthogonal to span{v1,...,vN,x1,...,xN,xhat}; dimension at most 2N+1<d. Set the final fixed operator equal to F_V.

For every prior query xt, every vi with i>=t is orthogonal to xt. Each term omitted from F_t has gate argument zero, so its value and ALL derivatives vanish. Thus D^kF_V(xt)=D^kF_t(xt) for every 0<=k<=p-1, equality of entire tensors, not only queried contractions.

Induction on deterministic query rules makes this exactly the transcript and output of the single fixed final F_V. Membership follows from flat_chain_properties. Since <vm,xhat>=0, its hidden-slab conclusion yields the stated obstruction.

Set R=D/2 and invert the power law only when the threshold is strictly above epsilon. For uniform normalization, Section11.3 uses Lemma11.5: on [-D/2,D/2], constant operators +M and -M with M>epsilon have disjoint singleton solution endpoints; the same zero-query output distribution cannot succeed with probability 2/3 on both. Combining T>=1 with the finite-N obstruction gives the displayed uniform bound.
proofs.omitted_details: Precise source-linked proof map; not a claim of a full independent reproof or formal verification.
proofs.reading_coverage: Original PDF pp7–9,25–31 read directly via extraction; native attached pp8,25–31 inspected. Theorem11.1 and its proof read in full on p28.

assumptions: Algorithm is deterministic and adaptive, makes at most N feasible exact-jet queries and returns any feasible output, which need not have been queried.
Rules may use the entire transcript and arbitrary internal operations; no span or tensor-update restriction.
statement.conclusion: r_tan(xhat)>=lambda R/(8m)=LpR^p/[8Bp16^(p-1)m^((3p-1)/2)]. Consequently T_p^det(epsilon;Lp,D)=Omega_p((LpD^p/epsilon)^(2/(3p-1))) in the high-dimensional worst-case model. A finite-N failure requires the residual threshold to be STRICTLY greater than epsilon. Uniform small-budget normalization uses the source-local Lemma11.5 and Section11.3 interface, not an additional unpublished theorem.
statement.objects_and_definitions: Use exactly the eta/chi/rho/h_tau and T_V,F_V definitions of thm.arxiv2609_13462.flat_chain_properties. X=B_2^d(R), x0=0, m=N+1, q=1-1/(2m), c=R/(2sqrt(m)), tau=R/(16m^(3/2)), Bp=max{1,||rho^(p-1)||infinity}, lambda=Lp tau^(p-1)/Bp. At a feasible x the order-p oracle returns (F,DF,...,D^(p-1)F), with entire tensors. r_tan=dist(0,F+N_X) with outward normal cone.
statement.parameter_domains: As above. Diameter calibration uses D=2R and epsilon>0; p-dependent constants are for fixed p.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every allowed parameter choice and every such deterministic algorithm, there exists an orthonormal frame V, hence one fixed admissible operator F_V, on which its output satisfies the bound. No randomness is required.

summary: Every N-query adaptive deterministic feasible algorithm has an adversarial fixed flat-chain instance with residual at least LpR^p/[8Bp16^(p-1)(N+1)^((3p-1)/2)] in dimension d>=2N+2, even with an unqueried output.
title: Unrestricted deterministic exact-jet lower bound for the flat chain
use_when: Lower-bound deterministic complete exact-jet oracle complexity for monotone VI tangent residual.
Do not treat the resisting construction alone as a randomized lower bound.
